name: Total coin-in
definition: Sum of paid wagers, including replayed winnings.
limitations: Includes replayed winnings, so it exceeds cash put into machines.

name: Total payout
definition: Sum returned from game outcomes; jackpots counted once.

name: Total house win
definition: Coin-in minus payout (house gaming win).
assumptions: Negative values are valid outcomes, never errors.

name: Theoretical win
definition: Expected house win given the bets actually made.
formula: SUM(theo_cents) / 100, where theo = bet x (1 - configured_rtp)
limitations: Exposure benchmark, not a guaranteed result. Assumes configured RTP is what the machine actually runs.

name: Observed hold
definition: Share of coin-in kept by the house.
limitations: Never average daily holds; always a ratio of sums.

name: Theoretical hold
definition: Expected share of coin-in kept by the house.

name: Luck residual (machine view)
definition: How much more (or less) the house won than expected.
limitations: Sign is opposite to the player-table residual (net + theo).

name: Luck residual standard deviation
definition: Standard deviation of house win around theo implied by the game math.
assumptions: Spins are independent; per-spin payout variance from game_math applies.
limitations: Normal approximation is weak for very_high volatility games with few spins; use with caution for short windows.

name: Luck z-score
definition: Residual in units of its standard deviation.
assumptions: |z| > ~3 is unlikely under pure luck; adjust for multiple comparisons.

name: Observed hit rate
definition: Share of paid spins with a positive payout.
limitations: A hit can pay less than the wager.

name: Hit-rate z-score vs configured
definition: Binomial test of observed hits against configured hit_probability.
formula: (hits - spins x p) / SQRT(spins x p x (1 - p))
assumptions: Spins independent; config constant within the group.
limitations: Detects payout-frequency anomalies, not payout-size anomalies.

name: Scheduled machine hours
definition: Hours the machine was on the floor during gaming days.
assumptions: Uses actual gaming-day length (82,800 s on 2025-03-08, DST).

name: Available machine hours
definition: Scheduled hours minus outage, repair, move and install downtime.

name: Availability rate
definition: Share of scheduled time available.

name: Downtime
definition: Scheduled but unavailable hours.

name: Win per available hour
definition: House win normalised by exposure (time the machine could be played).
limitations: Still contains luck; compare with theo_per_available_hour.

name: Theo per available hour
definition: Luck-free demand per unit of exposure.
limitations: Reflects bet volume and configured RTP; location and game appeal are confounded.

name: Carded player wagers
definition: Coin-in recorded to a loyalty card.
limitations: Tracked play only; never a substitute for all-play coin-in.

name: Carded player payouts
definition: Payout on carded play.

name: Tracked player gaming net (player view)
definition: What tracked players won (+) or lost (-).
limitations: Label 'tracked'; uncarded play invisible at person level.

name: Comp cost (economic)
definition: Cost to the house of redeemed comps.
formula: SUM(fnb_transactions.cogs_cents WHERE comp_id IS NOT NULL) / 100  (== SUM(loyalty_ledger.economic_cost_cents) / 100)
assumptions: Already inside POS cogs; subtract once.
limitations: Face value is menu price, not revenue and not cost.

name: Comp reinvestment rate
definition: Comp economic cost relative to theo for the same period.
limitations: Numerator is carded-guest comps, denominator is all-play theo unless carded theo is used; state which.

name: Supplied machine operating costs
definition: Lease, service contract, power and direct repair costs from cost_rules.
limitations: Partial costs: no rent, tax, depreciation or full staffing.

name: Contribution after supplied costs
definition: House win minus supplied machine costs (machine) or plus POS margin minus all supplied costs (property).
